CREATE TABLE operation_events (
	id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	operation_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	operation_kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	engagement_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(200), 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(300), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_operation_events_idempotency UNIQUE (operation_id, idempotency_key), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_operation_events_sequence UNIQUE (operation_id, sequence)
)

CREATE TABLE resource_relations (
	id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	source_kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	source_id VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, 
	source_revision INTEGER, 
	predicate VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	target_kind VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(4096) NOT NULL, 
	target_revision INTEGER, 
	attribution VARCHAR(200), 
	provenance JSON NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_resource_relations_edge UNIQUE (project_id, source_kind, source_id, predicate, target_kind, target_id)
)

CREATE TABLE run_events (
	id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	run_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	sequence INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_type VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	payload JSON NOT NULL, 
	actor_id VARCHAR(200), 
	occurred_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(300), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_run_events_sequence UNIQUE (run_id, sequence), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_run_events_idempotency UNIQUE (run_id, idempotency_key)
)

CREATE TABLE session_projections (
	session_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	revision BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES entities (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
CREATE INDEX ix_operation_events_engagement_time ON operation_events (engagement_id, occurred_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_operation_events_replay ON operation_events (operation_id, sequence)
CREATE INDEX ix_resource_relations_lineage ON resource_relations (project_id, created_at)
CREATE INDEX ix_resource_relations_source ON resource_relations (project_id, source_kind, source_id, predicate)
CREATE INDEX ix_resource_relations_target ON resource_relations (project_id, target_kind, target_id, predicate)
CREATE INDEX ix_run_events_replay ON run_events (run_id, sequence)

CREATE TRIGGER trg_operation_events_no_delete
            BEFORE DELETE ON operation_events
            BEGIN
                SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'operation events are immutable');
            END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_operation_events_no_update
            BEFORE UPDATE ON operation_events
            BEGIN
                SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'operation events are immutable');
            END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_run_events_no_delete
            BEFORE DELETE ON run_events
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'run events are append-only'); END

CREATE TRIGGER trg_run_events_no_update
            BEFORE UPDATE ON run_events
            BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'run events are append-only'); END
